info.name: Req4 Policy API Route Characterization
info.description: Characterizes current mock route availability for REQ4-01 through REQ4-12. The mock registers only /claims routes, so each policy request is expected to return HTTP 404. These assertions document mock behavior only; they are not policy business acceptance criteria. Req4 candidate payloads are unvalidated and expected business outcomes remain TBD.
